hypothesis: A closed, versioned manifest of all repository-owned core/MCP served JavaScript detects dependency drift that v14's selected-artifact list misses before provider contact.
visionGuardrails: Original source evidence and historical failed runs remain authoritative and recoverable.
Semantic schema, registry, fingerprint projection and parser vocabulary are unchanged.
Model and product independence remain intact; these are evaluation-client provenance gates.
Deterministic runtime binding is not semantic fidelity, human review or deployed trust.

data.datasetHashBasis: baseline git blob before changing tests

hardGates: Missing, changed, added, deleted or symlink-escaped repository-owned served JavaScript invalidates live artifact binding.
Missing or malformed runtime manifests cannot count as valid live evidence.
Frozen v14 artifacts and old runs are never edited.
No existing service, external repository, semantic identity or protected gold is changed.
nonClaims: This binds repository-owned served artifacts, not all operating-system binaries or dependency supply-chain authenticity.
AJV installed version and lockfile remain explicit separate checks; immutable provider weights may be unavailable.
No model quality or readiness claim follows from a passing handshake.
